description: Guide a student to extend a backtest engine to support synchronized multi-asset replay for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT daily data, then implement a BTC/ETH ratio mean-reversion strategy with per-asset accounting.

student_openings.beginner_no_finance: I have Bitcoin and Ethereum price data. I heard you can trade the ratio between them. But how do I even backtest something that involves two assets at the same time?
student_openings.intermediate_developer: I need to build a multi-asset backtester. My current engine handles one asset at a time. How should I restructure it to replay multiple assets in sync and track positions per asset?
student_openings.advanced_quant: I'm building a multi-asset backtest engine for crypto futures. I need synchronized bar replay with proper timestamp alignment, per-asset position tracking, and a clean multi-asset strategy API. What's the architecture?

ground_truth.expected_outcome: Student produces a backtest system where (1) the data layer loads and time-aligns BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT daily data, handling timestamp mismatches, (2) the engine replays synchronized bar tuples, (3) the strategy receives both current bars simultaneously and computes a ratio-based signal, and (4) the engine tracks positions in both assets with separate PnL accounting. The system runs end-to-end and reports per-asset and combined performance, leaving concrete multi-asset replay and accounting artifacts.
required_capabilities: Load and time-align multiple asset data series
Build a synchronized multi-asset replay mechanism
Track positions and PnL separately per asset
Implement a ratio-based mean-reversion strategy that operates on synchronized data
Produce per-asset and portfolio-level performance metrics
